world: A_gliders + wind channel (actuation/wind.py, unchanged): 8 x 8 x 2 block forces, Gaussian blur 8 px, held for the 20 substeps of a tick, background a~ = u + sigma_w eta once per tick

a_viability.design: init + 50 burn-in + 250 ticks, no input; keys shared across sigma_w (paired); pooled with the 3 actuation members (seed 9001, same design) for 9 per sigma_w
a_viability.statistics: actuation/viability.traj_stats (objects present, speed median/p90, mass and rg median, births/deaths/fusions/fissions per 100 ticks, track life median, share of tracks >= 50 ticks)
a_viability.native_band: 2.5-97.5% of means of n trajectories resampled from the 36 wind-free closure trajectories (sim_A/sim_B, ticks 0..250), n = number of members compared
a_viability.rule: sigma_w passes if every statistic's member mean lies in the native band for that n AND no paired difference to sigma_w = 0 (same keys) exceeds 3 SE
a_viability.oracle_cost: 12 sigma_w = 0 states (6 members x ticks 100, 200), R = 6 branches x 16 ticks at each sigma_w with keys shared across sigma_w; dV(sigma) = V_oracle(sigma) - V_oracle(0) in closure-sd units, relative to the fresh closure V_best (h = 1, 2, 4, 8, 16), both views
a_viability.decision: 0.1 replaces 0.05 only if 0.1 passes the viability rule and its measured dV is <= 0.10 V_best at every horizon in both views; otherwise 0.05 stands if it passes

b_closure.estimator: closure_lib.closure_ext (the checked line-for-line copy of integrate/analyze.closure, with its 'extra' hook): mean, persistence, AR(1), ridge on 1/2/4/8 lags, kNN, VW-0 MLP (+ kinematic and kin+ridge_p4 for objects); 4 folds by trajectory; errors against the base + 5 branch replicates; unmodified analyze.closure (MLP off) must agree exactly; JAX rmlp/patchnet/slotnet if CPU allows

set_P.test_classes: balanced quotas over the 96 test items (24 per class), shuffled (seed 9204); non-test episodes iid with equal shares

program_mix.definitions:
wr -- shared pieces of the wind recertification (track2/wind_recert).

The wind world is actuation/wind.py (imported, not changed) at background sigma_w; level 1 is
<Phi_coarse (192), Phi_objects (144)> as in vw1/fresh/closure. One run call = one tick per step.

Declared exam program mix (equal shares; every program lasts T_IN = 4 ticks from the episode start,
budget split equally over the 4 ticks; built from the state at the episode start, open loop):
  none      u = 0
  blind     a 2 x 2 block group at a uniformly random block corner (i0, j0) and a uniformly random
            direction, fixed for 4 ticks; force f = sigma_w sqrt(C / (2 T_IN)); C ~ logU[150, 700] nats
            (state-independent: the blind counterpart of 'aimed')
  aimed     actuation/programs.wind_aimed on programs.pick_target (the 2 x 2 group follows the target's
            extrapolated path), C ~ logU[150, 700] nats
  regional  actuation/programs.wind_regional (4 x 4 blocks around the target, fixed), C = 700 nats
            (the per-episode budget, EXAM class (d))
Charges are 0.5 |u|^2 / sigma_w^2 summed over ticks (wind.nats).

b_closure.matched_reference: the same estimator on the wind-free closure data cut to 16 trajectories (8 from sim_A, 8 from sim_B), ticks 0..236, test ticks 40/100/160/220, branches cut to 16 ticks
b_closure.inputs: level-1 predictors with inputs: ridge on 1/2/4 lags plus input features of the declared future commands in [t, t+h): the cumulative block command (128), the block-averaged displacement field 4 * sum E(u) (128), and for coarse the central-difference advection of the block means and m2 by that displacement (192); for objects the displacement at each slot's extrapolated centroid (dx, dy, and the induced change of the 4 position coordinates, 6 per slot) and a kinematic+wind predictor with a ridge residual; the input-blind twins use the same lags and data without the input features
b_closure.exam_effect: per item d = err(best input-blind) - err(best input-aware), by class and pooled, relative to V_best (input-aware best-of); detectability z = mean(d) / (sd(d) / sqrt(n)) at n = 64, 128 for R = 1, 6 and (extrapolated) 16 replicate truths; also the true mean effect of each program from the no-input twins (unbiased squared shift and the paired CRN version)

cpu: core 0 only, one heavy process at a time; about 3 CPU-hours in all
